🚨ATTENTION TEXT SCAMMERS🚨

Um, if you're going to claim to be "State of Connecticut Department of Vehicles(DMV)" don't, and I can't emphasize this enough, SEND THE TEXT FROM A PHONE WITH THE +63 COUNTRY CODE FOR THE PHILIPPINES 🤦🏻‍♂️

Scammer Text:

"State of Connecticut Department of Vehicles(DMV) Final Notice: Enforcement Penalties Begin on August 20.

Our records show that as of today, you still have an outstanding traffic ticket. In accordance with State of Connecticut Administrative Code 15C-16.003, If you do not complete payment by August 19, 2025, we will take the following actions:

1. Report to the DMV violation database

2. Suspend your vehicle registration starting August 20

3. Suspend driving privileges for 30 days

4. Transfer to a toll booth and charge a 35% service fee

5. You may be prosecuted and your credit score will be affected

Pay Now:
